title: Court move or empty city?
hook: Compare court location and community life.

knows: Selected accounts can describe distinct institutions and dated changes.
doesNotKnow: Khmer court relocations and continuity of inhabited places after court movement

objective: Khmer court relocations and continuity of inhabited places after court movement

claims.text: Polkinghorne reports Ponhea Yat’s court branch moving from Basan to Phnom Penh after an indeterminate stay, while rival Cambodian political centres continued; the account does not establish one uncontested relocation date.

claims.text: Polkinghorne distinguishes a court branch moving through Basan to Phnom Penh from rival centres and uncertain dates. At Angkor, later patronage and monastic life continued while political authority lay at Longvek. Court location, inhabited communities and religious institutions are different relations. Continued life does not erase wartime displacement; the uncollated chronicles do not establish one uncontested capital or relocation date.
claims.source: https://angkordatabase.asia/libs/docs/publications/reconfiguring-kingdoms-the-end-of-angkor-and-the-emergence-of-early-modern-period-cambodia/Polkinghorne_M._2018_._Reconfiguring_Kin.pdf; PDF page 8, printed pp.262–263, right column; visually inspected; selected representation SHA256 e38492ad246fe9cf9be2c62ff4f4d6ac0920b493c7a5b50647de9afb5336685a; https://angkordatabase.asia/libs/docs/publications/reconfiguring-kingdoms-the-end-of-angkor-and-the-emergence-of-early-modern-period-cambodia/Polkinghorne_M._2018_._Reconfiguring_Kin.pdf; PDF page 10, printed pp.266–267, Return to Angkor section; visually inspected; selected representation SHA256 e38492ad246fe9cf9be2c62ff4f4d6ac0920b493c7a5b50647de9afb5336685a; https://angkordatabase.asia/libs/docs/publications/reconfiguring-kingdoms-the-end-of-angkor-and-the-emergence-of-early-modern-period-cambodia/Polkinghorne_M._2018_._Reconfiguring_Kin.pdf; PDF page 8, pp.262–263; PDF page 10, pp.266–267; visually inspected; selected representation SHA256 e38492ad246fe9cf9be2c62ff4f4d6ac0920b493c7a5b50647de9afb5336685a

recall.question: What evidence defeats total abandonment after the court moved?
options: Patronage, monastic life and communities continued at Angkor.
Moving the court proves everyone abandoned Angkor.
recall.why: Angkor’s documented patronage, monastery and enduring communities differ from the court branch and political authority at other centres.

care: War displacement and enduring communities both visible; no romantic empty-city tale or a monastic institution equated with sovereign court.
